topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Incorrect Resource Transfer Between Spheres Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains an incorrect resource transfer between spheres vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Apache Tomcat Missing Encryption of Sensitive Data Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Apache Tomcat contains a missing encryption of sensitive data vulnerability that allows the bypass of the EncryptInterceptor. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE‑2025‑24813.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Apache ActiveMQ Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Apache ActiveMQ contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows for code injection.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiClient EMS Improper Access Control Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiClient EMS contains an improper access control vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via crafted requests.

Citrix NetScaler ADC (formerly Citrix ADC), NetScaler Gateway (formerly Citrix Gateway) and NetScaler ADC FIPS and NDcPP contain an out-of-bounds reads vulnerability when configured as a SAML IDP leading to memory overread.

BerriAI LiteLLM contains a SQL injection vulnerability that allows an attacker to read data from the proxy's database and potentially modify it, leading to unauthorized access to the proxy and the credentials it manages.
Drupal Core contains a SQL injection vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation and remote code execution via specially crafted requests sent with the database abstraction API.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Ubiquiti UniFi OS Improper Access Control Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Ubiquiti UniFi OS contains an improper access control vulnerability which could allow a malicious actor with access to the network to make unauthorized changes to the system.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution or denial of service

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper input validation vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server OS Command Injection Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Collabora Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server when used within the NextCloud platform contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows for remote code execution when the CODE server isn't running.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator SQL Injection Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator on-prem contains a SQL injection vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition OS Command Injection Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition contains an OS command injection vulnerability which may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary OS commands with root or SYSTEM privileges on the system running the affected product.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server External Control of File Name or Path Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains an external control of file name or path vulnerability which can allow an admin user to write arbitrary files that may be executed on load. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96655.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server Improper Neutralization of Encoded URI Schemes in a Web Page Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains an improper neutralization of encoded URI schemes in a web page vulnerability that could allow an attacker to call other plugins' functions and supply their own parameters. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Siemens Software Center Uncontrolled Search Path Element Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Siemens Software Center contains an uncontrolled search path element vulnerability that could allow an authenticated local attacker to place a specially crafted DLL in a directory that the application searches, leading to arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the affected application.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to request arbitrary internal or external addresses via the '/video/:/transcode/universal' path parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96656.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability which could allow an attacker using any X-Plex-Token value to include a full URL in the 'protocol' parameter and force the Plex server to POST to the attacker's chosen destination. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96654, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.
